evals.prompt: Transcribe this authorized local recording without translating it.
evals.expected_output: Original-language raw and reviewed text, provenance, and uncertainty.
assertions: The original spoken language is preserved.

evals.prompt: Give me exact sentence timestamps from this chunk-only recognizer output.
evals.expected_output: Honest chunk ranges, with finer alignment requested or verified separately.
assertions: Chunk ranges are not presented as exact sentence timestamps.

evals.prompt: Transcribe this excerpt without installing anything; the speech model is missing.
evals.expected_output: A prerequisite blocker without installation or silent caption substitution.
assertions: No dependencies or models are installed.
